newsitem.title: UK: Analysts bet against BT reworking MCI deal.
newsitem.headline: Analysts bet against BT reworking MCI deal.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc is unlikely to renegotiate its $24 billion merger with MCI Communications Corp despite the American long-distance carrier's profit warning, telecoms analysts said on Friday.
"I can't rule it out, BT can't rule it out, but I think it's unlikely," said Andrew Harrington, telecoms analyst at Salomon Brothers.

"BT has been going around for the last six months saying what a great strategic acquisition it is and we agree with that. I think any renegotiation on that would be a loss of face and more importantly damage confidence in BT's ability to deliver strategic goals."
